run_racecar_episode: run a PyBullet racecar environment episode using a loaded DeepQ model and print the episode reward
create_racecar_env: create a RacecarGymEnv with rendering enabled and discrete action space for the racecar simulation
load_deepq_model: load a trained DeepQ agent from a pickle file to use for racecar control decisions
reset_env: reset the racecar gym environment to get the initial observation and start a new episode
step_env_with_action: step the racecar environment forward using an action from the DeepQ model and collect the reward
